answer: Each identity files one unique artifact: a summit logbook of a real wander route, sealed by a raven courier's receipt on a public registry. Auditors replay the route; a forged or reused seal burns the 60-credit bond. The first filing costs 38 credits, the k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 credits plus 60,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. A rented logbook fails replay and burns both bonds. An honest agent files once.
